seo: AI data enrichment for contacts and products
meta: Missing details in your contacts, products or orders filled in from trusted sources you approve. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Data enrichment that fills in missing details
overview: Half-empty spreadsheets slow everyone down. This workflow takes a list you already own, such as products, customers or suppliers, and fills gaps like category, size, country or company type from sources you approve, including your own other files. Each filled cell shows where it came from, and doubtful matches are marked for a person to check instead of being guessed.

list: Handover notes and a test run

faq: Where does the extra information come from?
From your own data, public pages you point us to and sources whose terms allow this use. We do not scrape private data or buy contact lists. Each value shows its source.
Can you find personal emails or phone numbers for me?
No. We fill in business and product details only. We will not build lists of private individuals or break a website's rules to gather information.
How accurate will the filled data be?
It depends on the quality of your starting list. We test a sample with you, mark anything uncertain for review and report the match rate honestly rather than promise a number.
What file formats can you work with?
Google Sheets, Excel and CSV files, plus Airtable and most CRM exports. We return the result in the same format so you can load it straight back.
